runs.hypothesis: Small-cap stocks exhibit short-term reversal following days of abnormally high volume, driven by liquidity-driven selling pressure that temporarily overshoots fundamentals.

factors.name: vol_reversal_rank
factors.explanation: Scores stocks based on the percentage change in return after days with high volume relative to recent trends, ranked across the cross-section.

factors.name: vol_reversal_zscore
factors.explanation: Standardizes the percentage change in return after high-volume days, capturing deviations from cross-sectional mean.

factors.name: vol_reversal_tsmad
factors.explanation: Measures the deviation of returns after high-volume days using median absolute deviation over a 10-day window.

factors.name: vol_reversal_rank_diff
factors.explanation: Compares the rank of returns with the rank of volume anomalies, highlighting mispricing from liquidity shocks.

factors.name: vol_reversal_conditional_zscore
factors.explanation: Gates the standardization of return changes on the condition of high volume, isolating the reversal signal.

factors.name: vol_reversal_rank_trend
factors.explanation: Ranks the return changes after high-volume days within a 10-day time-series window, capturing momentum within the reversal.

runs.hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: Low-volatility stocks exhibit mean-reversion during regime transitions, with higher returns following a period of low volatility and market uncertainty.

factors.name: vol_revert_zscore
factors.explanation: Computes the z-score of rolling volatility over 20 days, weighted by a volume increase signal over 5 days, capturing mean reversion in volatile regimes.

factors.name: vol_revert_rank
factors.explanation: Ranks rolling volatility over 30 days, multiplied by a volume decline signal over 10 days, highlighting mean reversion in low-volume, uncertain regimes.

factors.name: vol_revert_diff
factors.explanation: Calculates the difference between short and long-term returns, gated by low volatility over 30 days, identifying mean reversion after periods of stability.

factors.name: vol_revert_corr
factors.explanation: Measures the correlation between returns and volume over 20 days, conditioned on low volatility over 10 days, capturing regime-based mean reversion.

factors.name: vol_revert_quantile
factors.explanation: Uses the 20th percentile of rolling volatility over 40 days, multiplied by a volume increase signal over 15 days, focusing on extreme low-volatility transitions.

runs.hypothesis: When low-volatility stocks exhibit regime transitions, they show mean-reversion in the next-period cross-sectional returns.

factors.name: vol_revert_diff

factors.name: vol_revert_tsmad

factors.name: vol_revert_corr

factors.name: vol_revert_quantile
